purpose: Refresh current-code v1 regression baseline; no answer-quality or generalization claim.
order: index; baseline methods rotated per case; agent dataset order, three fresh conversations per case
cache_policy: Provider cache is not cleared; first-use loading retained in raw latency. No warm/cold performance comparison.
retry_policy: No task retries; failed tasks remain. Index build uses normal indexing retry policy.
error_policy: Preserve original v1 null/denominator semantics; no baseline task-success substitution.
validity_gate: Exact planned matrix, successful offline metric replay, unchanged corpus/code/model/snapshot fingerprints, full Qdrant snapshot verification.
release_quality_gate: Not a product release gate; known v1 failures are retained without threshold relaxation.
